formatter.description: Explicit JavaScript formatter. Omit to preserve repository scripts and the Oxfmt fallback.

release_qualification_receipts.description: Opt in to seven-day exact-tree qualification receipts for Release Please validation.

build_budget_file.description: Opt in to the Build time ceiling: a repository-relative JSON file whose lanes.build.ceilingSeconds the CI Build must not exceed. Empty or omitted leaves the Build unbudgeted. See docs/build-budgets.md.

npm_publish_auth.description: npm publisher authentication: auto preserves token users and uses OIDC when no publish token is present; oidc forces trusted publishing; token requires NPM_TOKEN.
